dedupe_keys.name: edf landfill methane map u s municipal landfills violations and emissions

description: The EDF Landfill Methane Map compiles environmental compliance and emissions information for 1,122 municipal solid waste landfills in the United States, about 92 percent of all such landfills. For each site it combines greenhouse gas emissions self-reported to the EPA's Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program, current and historic violations and enforcement actions under the Clean Air, Clean Water, Resource Conservation and Recovery and Safe Drinking Water Acts from EPA's Enforcement and Compliance History Online, flags for environmental justice communities and ozone nonattainment areas, and whether satellite data suggest emissions are underestimated. The provider is the Environmental Defense Fund, a non-profit organisation. Coverage is national at facility level, with violations for 2021–2023 and a data summary last updated in March 2024. The map and the full dataset are free to view and download, under EDF's terms of use; no open licence is named. Caveats: it is an advocacy compilation of federal data, compliance status changes quickly, satellite comparisons cover only some sites and years, and industrial and hazardous waste landfills are excluded. Simulation uses: landfill locations and condition for hazard exposure of waste disposal capacity, and methane and compliance attributes for climate and environmental justice scenarios. Related records: the EPA LMOP landfill database (data-epa-lmop-landfill-and-project-database) gives capacity and gas projects.
